adjudication_document.assessment_sha256: Ordered exact immutable byte hashes of complete stream indexes a then b. Both inventories and all originals must already be sealed. Every adjudication segment also binds those index byte hashes.
adjudication_document.cases: Every segment contains only the cases actually inspected by its genuine session, at most4. The complete adjudication stream must cover all required disagreements/agreed negatives and may include other actually inspected cases. Segment/session provenance is never collapsed into a single inspecting session.
adjudication_document.required_set: All raw label disagreements across visibility,x,y,uncertainty_radius,scene,difficulty tag sets, plus all agreed not_visible cases. Differences in reasons or inspected context do not erase their originals but are not label disagreements.
adjudication_document.resolution: Explicit source-based decision and inspection record, preserving unknowns and raw differences. Never average points or silently replace originals. Matching nonnegative cases without adjudication retain two-assessor agreement and do not claim third inspection.

adjudication_stream.assessment_sha256: Ordered exact immutable byte hashes of complete stream indexes a then b. Both inventories and all originals must already be sealed. Every adjudication segment also binds those index byte hashes.
adjudication_stream.owner: The owning task session coordinates bounded independent adjudication sessions. Each case names its actual inspecting session through its immutable segment. Root does not claim third inspection of cases seen only by other sessions.
adjudication_stream.required_set: All raw label disagreements across visibility,x,y,uncertainty_radius,scene,difficulty tag sets, plus all agreed not_visible cases. Differences in reasons or inspected context do not erase their originals but are not label disagreements.
adjudication_stream.resolution: Explicit source observation and decision for every disagreement and agreed negative. Preserve original segment bytes, raw differences, unknowns and actual inspection identities. No averaging or silent replacement. Matching other cases retain two-stream agreement without claiming third inspection.
adjudication_stream.segment_schema: The source_only_adjudication document fields below, with adjudicator_id adjudication and at most4 cases per actual genuine session; exactly one original segment per session. Use the same6MiB unique inspected-image budget and native source viewing rules. No session may also be an assessor.

assessment_document.all_cases: Each source-only assessment segment covers its explicit assigned subset of1..4 cases. The complete stream index covers all128 original cases exactly once; no center is dropped. Every available center is actually viewed at original resolution. Context remains optional.
assessment_document.difficulty: Nonempty unique tag list. ordinary cannot coexist with other tags. unresolved may coexist with observed difficulty. Tags describe observed support, not a forced balanced category.
assessment_document.inspected_frames: Unique entries {frame: native integer ordinal, image_sha256: actual sealed PNG SHA256}. Include the center when available and only actually viewed declared context frames. For unavailable centers retain unknown with an explicit reason; never invent an inspection.
assessment_document.negative_evidence: Nonempty affirmative evidence explanation of at least10 characters for not_visible; null otherwise. A non-play scene may contain a grounded shuttle and is not automatically negative. Inability to find a tiny object is unknown.
assessment_document.reason: A nonempty concrete source observation for every case, including uncertainty. Do not claim a session inspected an image unless the view tool was actually used.

assessment_streams.fresh_start: Repeat all128 cases in each stream. Preserve incomplete163 originals but never transplant their partial labels into this procedure.
assessment_streams.independence: Every genuine fresh session belongs to exactly one stream or adjudication. Sessions cannot see another assessment, prior163/139 labels, research code, models, predictions, heatmaps or application truth.
assessment_streams.inspection: Actually view assigned original native center PNGs using the image tool at original resolution. Only declared context may be viewed as needed. Count unique inspected PNG bytes per session. Optional context is bounded by the same6MiB transport cap. Unknown remains unknown; never invent an inspection or move a neighbor point to a hidden center.
assessment_streams.provenance_limit: Stream agreement represents multiple genuine sessions with case-level provenance, never a claim that one session inspected the whole sample. Software cannot establish visual inspection or actual session independence.
assessment_streams.seal_order: Seal every segment and both complete assessor indexes before comparing labels or starting adjudication. Parent may assemble indexes mechanically without inspecting label values. Preserve exact inventories and all original bytes.
assessment_streams.segment_paths: Safe unique relative paths under segments/<stream_id>/, resolved relative to the index parent. Each entry binds exact original file bytes, actual session and exact ordered case keys. No missing, extra, duplicate or overlapping case membership. Every assessor index covers all128 cases exactly once.
assessment_streams.segment_schema: The schema_version1 source_only_assessment document fields defined below, but cases is a nonempty subset of at most4 assigned cases. assessor_id equals stream_id a or b. session_id is the actual genuine session that inspected every case in this segment. One session writes exactly one original segment. Header protocol/input hashes bind this prospective protocol and deterministic inputs. All original segment bytes are immutable.

coordinates.nullable: x,y,uncertainty_radius must all be null outside visible_localizable.
coordinates.space: Original oriented native image; zero-based pixel centers. No resizing, interpolation or neighboring-frame transfer.
coordinates.uncertainty: Finite uncertainty_radius in native pixels, at least1 and at most hypot(width,height). Estimate a source-supported disk; it is not a confidence score.
coordinates.visible_unlocalizable: Affirmatively visible at the center, but no defensible point can be placed. Explain the observation.

purpose: Source-only development agent assessment streams with bounded genuine sessions and explicit per-case provenance; not expert truth, an independent test, permission to train, or annotation accuracy.
rules: Preserve the prior v1 protocol and incomplete163 partial originals. Commit/publish this exact v2 protocol before any new visual inspection. Reverify all source/declaration/protocol/context/clock/PNG seals before new assessment and again before freeze.

Two independent source-only streams comprise disjoint genuinely fresh bounded sessions. A session belongs to only one stream or adjudication and must not access another assessment, prior163/139 labels, research code, models/predictions/heatmaps, application truth or consumed holdout63 inputs/predictions/protocols/private membership/artifacts.

Assessors receive only this protocol, deterministic blind input identities and their assigned unchanged160 native PNG cases. Each stream actually inspects every center at original resolution through the image tool; bounded declared neighbors may clarify appearance but cannot supply an unobserved center coordinate. Every segment records its actual session.
A source-only assessment may remain unknown. Neither image hashes nor software can prove actual visual inspection; preserve actual distinct sessions and inspection evidence and state this limitation.

Preserve original packets, unknown templates, all partial failures, immutable original assessment/adjudication segments, both complete stream indexes, raw differences and explicit source decisions in an exclusive ignored output. No existing data/application truth changes.
Keep all128 cases and640 requested memberships; unknown/unavailable support is never silently dropped or treated as absent. Deduplicated632 PNGs do not change denominators.

No new download/native decode, trained detector/inference/training/prediction comparison, threshold search, source/model/default registration, promotion, new dependencies, paid services or eligibility change.

Publish reproducible validation/freezing code, public protocol and aggregate support/agreement/limitations only. Raw PNGs, per-case labels and private inspection/session provenance remain ignored. Public availability does not establish media rights.

Case-level play/non-play/replay observations do not certify semantic full-match completeness, camera segmentation, original-match identity, upstream membership, independence or balanced difficult-case support.

Agent source assessments are not human/expert-certified truth or localization accuracy. Parent65/full product goal remain open; a separately frozen grant is required for a model experiment. Bounded sessions solve a transport limitation and do not establish independent human truth.

selection.clamped_edges: Retain every requested membership; deduplicate PNG storage only.
